description: Bipartite network of 18 Southern women attending 14 social events in the 1930s. Cell (i,j) is 1 if woman i attended event j. From the same UCINET source as ucinet-davis but preserved in bipartite (two-mode) form rather than one-mode projection.
name: Southern Women Event Attendance (Bipartite)
